new.tagline: Browser tools that shrink and resize animated GIFs, or clean SVG files and turn them into PNGs. AI generation of SVGs and GIFs is announced for later.

new.name: bakodo.jp: Make barcodes and QR codes at exact millimetre sizes and print them on label sheets
new.tagline: bakodo.jp is a browser tool in Japanese that makes barcodes in 111 formats and QR codes, sized in millimetres. It prints batches on A4 label sheets and writes commands for Zebra and TSC label printers.

new.name: BetaNeon: Browse new apps and public betas by category, or put your own product up for review
new.tagline: BetaNeon is a directory of new apps, early products and public betas, sorted into categories and tags. Makers submit through an account, and each listing is checked by a person before it goes live.

new.name: BPM Finder: Find the tempo and key of a song from the audio file, in your browser
new.tagline: BPM Finder measures the beats per minute and musical key of an audio or video file inside the browser. A studio area adds song recognition and an AI agent that turns a reference track into a brief for new music.

new.name: CalcaTools: Work out prayer times or zakat next to everyday sums like a mortgage payment
new.tagline: CalcaTools is a website with hundreds of browser calculators for everyday sums, plus Islamic and Hindu calendar and ritual calculators. It also has small tools for text, images, PDFs and code.

new.name: Central Alberta After Dark: Find platonic friends who are awake when your night shift ends
new.tagline: A friends-only community for night-shift workers and night owls in Central Alberta, Canada. Members find each other by schedule and interests, on the web or in an Android app.

new.name: ClipNoter: Turn a lecture or tutorial video into notes with timestamps and the slides that matter
new.tagline: ClipNoter turns an uploaded video or audio file into a summary, key points and timed sections, with the full transcript. A second mode adds still frames from the video next to the matching section.

new.name: ComicIdeas: Turn one sentence into a comic with the same characters in every panel
new.tagline: ComicIdeas writes a comic script from a one-sentence idea and draws the panels from character sheets. Speech bubbles and captions stay editable, and finished comics export as images or as print-ready PDF and CBZ books.

new.name: ContentPin Studio: Draft an illustrated blog post for WordPress and turn its images into Pinterest pins
new.tagline: ContentPin Studio writes illustrated article drafts from a topic and sends them to a self-hosted WordPress site. It then turns the article's images into Pinterest designs you can download.

new.name: Creepless: Sort each client request into included work or a paid extra before anyone starts on it
new.tagline: Creepless checks client requests against the scope agreed for each client. Work that fits goes to the team, and extras become quotes the client approves first.

new.name: Cutroom: Edit a video by describing the cuts in a chat, and check the plan before it renders
new.tagline: Cutroom is a browser-based video editor that takes instructions in plain language. It turns them into a list of cuts and captions that you check before anything is rendered.

new.name: EncodeKit: Turn Base64 strings and %20-filled web addresses back into readable text, or the reverse
new.tagline: EncodeKit is a set of web pages that encode and decode Base64 and URL percent-encoding. The conversion runs in the browser, with no account needed.

new.name: FoolFish Games: Play a quick puzzle, card or idle game in your browser, without installing anything
new.tagline: FoolFish Games is a browser-game platform with puzzles, card and board games, word games and idle clickers, many of them made by the studio itself. Games open in the browser, and an optional account syncs favourites and some saves.

new.name: Framed for Us: Turn one portrait each into six AI photos of the two of you somewhere you'd love to go
new.tagline: Framed for Us makes AI couple photos from two separate portraits, set in a destination you choose. A finished story holds six images and a photo strip, shared through a private gift page.

new.name: FrameWipe: Erase burned-in subtitles and on-screen text from videos, or blur faces, offline
new.tagline: FrameWipe is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that paints burned-in subtitles and text out of videos and photos. It can also hide faces, and the work happens on your own computer.

new.name: Hanashi: Book a video call with someone who shares your interests, with live translation
new.tagline: Hanashi books paid one-to-one video calls with hosts chosen by their interests, with live captions and translation. Hosts pass a short interview before they can take calls.

new.name: Headcanon Maker: Get small invented habits and backstories for the characters you write about
new.tagline: Headcanon Maker writes short invented details, pairing ideas, dialogue and backstories for fandom and original characters from a name and a few traits. Results can be edited, and characters can be saved to a private library.

new.name: Image Aspect Ratio: See a photo's exact aspect ratio and how it would fit a square or story frame
new.tagline: Image Aspect Ratio reads a photo's pixel size in the browser and shows its exact ratio, with Fit and Fill previews in common frames. Further calculators cover target sizes, video, ultrawide screens and square crops.

new.name: Locseek: Find a file on your Mac by its name as you type, even when you forgot the folder
new.tagline: Locseek is a Mac app that finds files and folders by name while you type, across the Mac, external drives and network storage. It runs offline and needs no account.

new.name: Look Morph: See a new hat or haircut on your own photo before you buy or book it
new.tagline: Look Morph redraws a portrait of you wearing an outfit, hat, bag, shoes or pants from a reference photo, or with a new haircut. A finished look can become a short GIF that turns the outfit to show its side and back.

new.name: Lumi: Describe a website or web app in a chat and get it built, with logins and a database
new.tagline: Lumi builds websites and web apps from a chat description and sets up the database and user sign-in behind them. It runs in the browser and as an app for iPhone and Android.

new.name: MapToSite: Give your shop a phone-sized web page that shows prices and opening hours
new.tagline: MapToSite builds a one-page mobile site for a local shop from its name, phone, hours and price list. A pasted Google Maps link adds the shop name and a Directions button.

new.name: Media to Words: Get the words from a Reel or your own recording as editable text and subtitles
new.tagline: Media to Words turns the speech in a public Instagram Reel or a saved audio or video file into text with timestamps. Saved files are transcribed inside the browser, and results export as TXT or SRT.

new.name: Mingzi: Write your name in Chinese, or find a real Chinese name that suits you
new.tagline: Mingzi spells English names in Chinese characters with pinyin and keeps a directory of real Chinese names with their meanings. A paid service picks three personal names, chosen by an AI with fixed checks or by a native-speaking expert.

new.name: MouseTestLab: Find out in your browser whether a mouse button double clicks or the wheel skips
new.tagline: MouseTestLab is a set of browser tests for a computer mouse: buttons, scroll wheel, double click faults, polling rate and DPI. Click speed tests for gamers and a few keyboard checks sit alongside.

new.name: NameOk: Check if your business name is taken as a domain or handle before you print cards
new.tagline: NameOk looks up a business name in domain registration records and on five social networks. A third section searches the App Store and Google Play, and each source shows its status as it finishes.

new.name: NomadBurn: Work out how many months your savings last in a remote-work city before you move
new.tagline: NomadBurn is a browser calculator for remote workers who plan to live abroad. It weighs your savings and income against a city's living costs and shows how many months the money lasts.

new.name: NotchMuse: Keep the lyrics of the song you are playing in view on your Mac while you work
new.tagline: NotchMuse is an open-source Mac app that shows the lyrics of the current song in the menu bar or beside the notch. It works with Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music.

new.name: Ocr4you: Get editable Hindi or other Indian-language text out of a photo, scan or old PDF
new.tagline: Ocr4you reads text from scans and photos in Hindi, English and other Indian scripts and returns Unicode text, Word, Excel or searchable PDF files. Next to the OCR it offers free PDF and image tools that run in the browser.

new.name: OpenFirmList: Find manufacturers and suppliers by product or place, with each firm on a map
new.tagline: OpenFirmList is a search engine for companies, with AI-written profiles of manufacturers and suppliers shown on a map. You search by product or region and can tell makers from resellers with one filter.

new.name: Owner Packets: Make a branded monthly PDF report for each property owner from your rental totals
new.tagline: A browser tool that turns a prepared CSV of monthly property totals into a branded PDF report for each owner. A second included tool does the same for Jobber visit exports.

new.name: PermitCore: Sell your app with license keys that limit devices and unlock features
new.tagline: PermitCore issues and checks license keys for software that developers sell. It offers a REST API, eight official SDKs and a branded store linked to the developer's payment provider.

new.name: Petfinnly: Find a cat or kitten near you, from a breeder or for adoption, across the US
new.tagline: A US marketplace for cats and kittens where breeders and rescues post animals and owners can rehome their own cat. It also has a directory of shelters and rescues sorted by state.

new.name: PiSpace Sky: See which night this week is clear and dark enough for stargazing near you
new.tagline: PiSpace Sky scores the coming nights for stargazing in towns around the world, from cloud cover across the dark hours and the brightness of the Moon. It also shows Moon times, aurora chances, eclipses and space station passes, with an optional email alert for good nights.

new.name: Ponka Cat: Put every phone and computer you own on one VPN subscription
new.tagline: Ponka Cat sells access to encrypted VPN servers with no limit on devices or traffic. You copy a key from its web dashboard into a VLESS-capable app on your phone or computer.

new.name: RoomLook Lab: Restyle a photo of your living room or bedroom as Scandinavian or Mid-century
new.tagline: RoomLook Lab turns a photo of a living room or bedroom into an AI concept of the same room in a new style. It offers two styles and works as a style preview before you buy furniture or paint.

new.name: Sandwich AI Sales Trainer: Rehearse a tough sales conversation with an AI customer before the real one
new.tagline: A web app where salespeople rehearse customer conversations with a simulated AI customer and get feedback after each attempt. Managers assign practice and follow progress up to a final exam.

new.name: SimpleACME: Renew HTTPS certificates on your own without giving out your DNS account key
new.tagline: SimpleACME takes over the DNS proof step of automatic certificate renewal through one permanent CNAME record. You keep your current DNS provider, and your website and email stay where they are.

new.name: SplatLoom: Turn a short phone video into a 3D scene you can spin, on your own computer
new.tagline: SplatLoom is a desktop app that turns photos or a short video into a Gaussian splat, a 3D scene you can explore. It runs on Mac and Windows and keeps the files on your computer.

new.name: SpriteAI: Turn a description or a picture into animated 2D sprites ready for your game engine
new.tagline: SpriteAI turns a text prompt or a reference image into an animated 2D sprite sheet in the browser. Each export holds a PNG grid, single frames, a GIF and atlas data for game engines.

new.name: StateTaxLab: Work out your US take-home pay by state and see how each paycheck tax was calculated
new.tagline: StateTaxLab is a paycheck calculator for US wages that shows federal tax, Social Security, Medicare and state taxes per pay period. Each line opens the formula and the official source behind it.

new.name: StuffWatch: Get an email before the warranty or return window on a purchase runs out
new.tagline: StuffWatch reads a receipt from a photo and emails you before warranties and return windows run out. It also checks your things against official product recalls and reminds you about food best-before dates.

new.name: Tapline: Put a QR code or NFC tag on your packaging that opens a product page with a reorder button
new.tagline: Tapline links a QR code or NFC tag on a product's label to a mobile page with the brand's story and a reorder button. The page can be edited after printing, and scans are counted per code.

new.name: TattooStencil: Make a tattoo stencil draft from a photo and check it against the original
new.tagline: TattooStencil is a website that turns an uploaded photo or drawing into a black-and-white tattoo stencil draft with an AI image model. The draft opens next to the original for comparison, and you download it as a PNG.

new.name: TreadmillPace: Convert the mph or km/h on a treadmill into your running pace, and back again
new.tagline: TreadmillPace converts treadmill belt speed into minutes per mile or per kilometre, and a target pace into the speed to set. It adds an incline estimate and a printable pace chart.

new.name: Tutti Studio: Get editable notes back from a sheet music PDF made in a notation program
new.tagline: Tutti Studio converts PDF scores exported from Sibelius, Dorico, MuseScore or Finale into editable MusicXML. A check in your browser shows first whether a PDF can be converted.

new.name: TypeMorse: Translate text to Morse and back, and practise until you can read the beeps by ear
new.tagline: TypeMorse translates between English and Morse code as you type and plays the result as sound or light. It also decodes Morse from audio or images and has a Koch method trainer and a speed test.

new.name: UpLearn: Run staff training online and in the classroom, and keep one record of who passed
new.tagline: UpLearn is a learning management system for large organisations that handles online courses and classroom sessions, with an exam engine built in. It runs as a hosted service, on a private cloud or on the company's own servers.

new.tagline: VPS Plan Check compares small rented Linux servers from several hosting providers by specs, region and billing terms. A cost calculator works out what a plan costs over the months you need it, renewal included.
